answer.why: Harbour City's pressure_rate jump (+5.2 sd) is best matched by a deliberate increase in press intensity (hyp-tactics-01) — it directly predicts the detected change and has a partly-consistent physical corollary (sprint_count up), while chasing the result (hyp-game_state-01) and Northvale fatigue/protection explanations also account for complementary signals (pressure rise and big long-ball increase) but fit less completely or rely on weakened corollaries.
